task: Telnyx SMS receive path: end-to-end diagnosis and fix

conclusion.fault_layer: Telnyx -> webhook dispatch (before the worker). Not the worker, not Telegram/Discord.
evidence: Cloudflare Workers analytics (workersInvocationsAdaptive, by minute and HTTP status) list every request the worker got since 2026-11-14 00:00Z: 07:09 200, 07:11 200 (2 subrequests = test forward), 07:54 401, 11:32 404, 13:19 200+401, 14:06 401+200x2, 15/11 11:44 404, 11:58 404. All are deploy-time tests or probes.

No request at 11:41Z 14/11 (Meta SMS 18:41 ICT), 13:07Z 14/11 (Henrry's test SMS 20:07 ICT) or around 14:00Z 15/11 (Meta 21:00 ICT). The analytics also record 401 and 404 (proved by this run's own probes), so a Telnyx webhook rejected by the signature check would still show up. Telnyx never reached the worker code.

The Cloudflare edge blocks only Python's default User-Agent (error 1010). curl, Telnyx-style, Go, Ruby, Mozilla and empty User-Agents all reach the worker (GET / 200, unsigned POST /telnyx 401). So Cloudflare is not blocking Telnyx.
The deployed code (version bb20d8d9, 14/11 14:06Z) is identical to telnyx-sms-relay/worker.js. Secrets present: TELNYX_PUBLIC_KEY, TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL.
conclusion.meta_today: Meta side, not Telnyx. The worker got nothing around 21:00 ICT 15/11, and the liaison's Message Detail Report has no inbound record. On 14/11 that same report even listed the SMS Telnyx blocked under the trial rule, so an SMS that reaches Telnyx shows up there even when blocked. A missing record means the SMS never reached Telnyx. Most likely Meta/short code 39041 is holding SMS after the 4 resends on 14/11. Per plan: no new code requested, no resend.
conclusion.symptom1_likely_cause: Telnyx did not send the message.received webhook to https://telnyx-sms-relay.vn-stock-ai.workers.dev/telnyx for either message. Hypotheses, in order: (a) at 18:41 ICT the webhook URL was not yet on profile 'SMS Receiving', or the number was not yet linked to the profile (the config was only confirmed at 21:16 ICT); (b) the 20:07 SMS was blocked by the Trial rule (unverified sender), and Telnyx does not send a webhook for blocked messages; (c) the profile's webhook URL is wrong or misspelled. A wrong path would show as a 404 at the matching minute, and none did, so a wrong host is more likely than a wrong path.

fixed: Turned on Workers Logs (observability, sampling 100%, persisted) for the telnyx-sms-relay worker via the settings API (code and secrets untouched) and pinned it in telnyx-sms-relay/wrangler.toml. Every future Telnyx webhook will be visible: time, path, status, signature-rejection log.

The LV1 scan job (lv1-host in the 'Telnyx SMS relay diagnostics' workflow) is still queued because the LV1 runner is busy with the Colab run 43725322373.
